analysis: The PR changes only documentation: CHANGELOG.md text entries and docs/developer/build.md, which updates a freshness stamp and adds a link to the workflow regression tests. No source, config, or runtime behavior changes. The units for docs/developer/build.md include a metadata-only unit (no text) and a patch unit. The CHANGELOG entries describe SSD prefix cache behavior, which relates to T-041, A-001 and TB-007. Examples are the 100 GiB default ceiling limited to half the available space, encrypted SSD checkpoints by default, and the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_MEMORY opt-in. These are descriptive claims. The unit text is the CHANGELOG itself and carries no code, so none of them can be validated here. Some wording diverges from the canonical T-041 text, which describes the default disk budget as half the available disk with no fixed ceiling. The changelog says the default ceiling was raised to 100 GiB. That divergence is a documentation drift and a possible threat-model update item, not a concrete regression, since the underlying code is not part of this diff. A later pass that sees the code should confirm the changelog entry against SSDPrefixCachePolicy and PrefixCachePolicy.ssdDiskBudgetBytes. I found no security regression or new attack surface in the docs changes.
